description: BROADCASTS A REAL, IRREVERSIBLE SOLANA MAINNET TRANSACTION that moves funds out of the agent’s own wallet. Sends native SOL (omit `mint`, or set mint:"native") or any SPL token (pass its base58 `mint` — supplied at call time, e.g. the $THREE mint or any token you hold). Signs locally with the per-call `secret` (base58) or SOLANA_SECRET_KEY on the server; for a token it auto-creates the recipient’s associated token account when missing. Returns the confirmed signature, the moved amount, and a Solscan link. EXECUTION ACTION — pass confirm:true to proceed. Native sends are capped by MAX_SOL_PER_TX; the recipient must be in RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST when one is configured.

amount.description: Amount to send, in human units as a decimal string (e.g. "1.5" SOL or "100" tokens).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this irreversible transfer (when REQUIRE_CONFIRM is on).

mint.description: SPL token mint (base58) to send. Omit or set "native" to send SOL. Runtime input — any mint you hold.

secret.description: Base58 secret of the sending wallet. Falls back to SOLANA_SECRET_KEY on the server.

name: send_transfer
title: Send SOL or an SPL token on Solana mainnet
